title: Add Fullscreen in Social and Coding Boxes, Refactor Settings Tab, and Add detail_PC.py
label: Development
summary: This update deploys immersive viewport expansion capabilities across independent desktop dashboard boxes, overhauls settings tab file management, and isolates host telemetry processes.

sections.title: Added & New Features
items: Engineered dedicated fullscreen toggle capabilities directly inside individual Social and Coding layout container boxes.
Created detail_PC.py to cleanly separate host hardware metrics collection and platform-specific environment data profiles.

sections.title: Improvements & System Redux
items: Refactored the Settings Tab codebase to cleanly separate UI presentation fields from the structural data configurations.

notes: Version 0.8.3.0 introduces crucial granular viewing control via individual dashboard block expansions. Isolating machine-specific discovery mechanisms into detail_PC.py guarantees that core frontend UI files remain platform-independent.
